report_discrepancies.note: Governmental funds Total revenues printed 545,995; the printed Total column lines add to 545,993 (General Fund column lines add to 423,515 vs printed 423,516). Rounding in the report.
Governmental funds Total expenditures printed 446,450; the printed Total column lines add to 446,451. Rounding in the report.

Fund balances end of year printed 537,023 (p7); beginning 431,478 + line items (545,993 - 446,451) + net transfers 6,000 = 537,020. The balance sheet (p5) and the column sums show 537,022. Rounding in the report.
Proprietary Total operating expenses printed 865,995; the Totals column expense lines add to 865,994. Rounding in the report.

Statement of Net Position TOTAL ASSETS printed 4,398,838; the Total column asset lines add to 4,398,839, which equals total liabilities 704,275 + deferred inflows 23,999 + net position 3,670,565. Rounding in the report.

Combining General Fund schedule Total expenditures printed 445,376; the department lines add to 445,379 (Public Safety row 88,807 vs 88,808, Capital outlay row 38,873 vs 38,874, Street and Fire department totals each off by 1).

notes: GAAP report. Governmental receipts/disbursements from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances (Total column, p6-7); fund balance 431,478 -> 537,023 as printed (see report_discrepancies for the rounding gaps). ending_cash from the governmental funds balance sheet (p5). 'General taxes' is not broken down anywhere in the trimmed PDF, so it stays taxes (unlabeled). Business-type from the proprietary statement (p10, Totals): 2,053,479 + 875,130 - 865,995 - 6,000 = 2,056,614. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column (pp1-2). Detail: Combining General Fund schedule by department (p14) and nonmajor combining schedule (p15, Keno only; CRA and Cemetery Perpetual Care have no activity). The budgetary-basis all-funds schedule (p13) is one combined column for all funds including utilities; not recorded to avoid double counting. Sales Tax Fund and the proprietary funds have no supplementary schedule, so no detail for them. Read pages 1-15 of 15
